entries.scope: Contain recursive parser nesting from untrusted PL/0 source
entries.rationale: The observable compiler contract now accepts syntax and lexical nesting through depth 10 and returns controlled diagnostics E36 or E32 at depth 11 instead of allowing host-stack exhaustion.
readerPaths: Language EBNF to implementation limits and parser architecture
TinyPl0.Core package guidance to diagnostics and safe processing
Threat model to quality scenario, checklist, ADR, and executable regression evidence
entries.navigationImpact: ADR 0003 is added to the existing architecture path; language, package, traceability, and security pages are updated in place.
entries.languageStrategy: User-facing guidance remains German first and English second at CEFR B2; stable diagnostic and code identifiers remain language-neutral.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Boundary tests cover expressions, begin, if, while, mixed nesting, direct parser use, lexical levels, malformed closure, German and English resources, and 10,000 hostile parentheses on .NET 10.
entries.risk: Low after focused and full regression gates; increasing the fixed ceiling would require cross-platform stack evidence.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: A change to recursive grammar productions, parser recovery, block-level semantics, public compiler options, diagnostics, localization, CLI/IDE presentation, or supported runtime architecture.
